_doc: Where the manual lane runs for this channel (read by src/autoslice/manual_lane/layout.py; each key can be overridden by MANUAL_LANE_<KEY>, nested keys joined by _). Host facts only: the room id comes from profile.json, the emote media root from the emote library, the intro file names from the branding-intro manifest. The intro copies and the cover font are derived from work_root (<work_root>/assets/intro, <work_root>/assets/fonts/RuiZiZhenYan.ttf); set intro_dir / cover_font only to pin them elsewhere.

speaker_v8._doc: The frozen v8 speaker workspace (TASK-5 item 8): its code and classifier, the CAM++ venv, model copy and scorer. Frozen artefacts, not a session's work directory.

free_asr._doc: BCUT / jianying pacing (U152). Basis: round 0b sent 16 whole-clip jobs back to back to jianying and 3 stayed on HTTP 429; the client's own retry (scripts/free_asr_client.py: 4 tries, 2, 4, 8 s apart, about 14 s in all) is inside one call and does not reach across clips. One call per provider at a time, at least min_interval_s apart across every clip and process on the host; a rate-limited answer waits rate_limit_cooldown_s before that provider is asked again, at most rate_limit_attempts times; any other failure is retried attempts times with the old 10/20/30 s steps. A clip ASR job takes 1-3 min, so a 60 s gap keeps the rate at or below about one job per provider per 1.5-4 min.
